Instrument specification for Molten Salt Services - Multipoint Temperature Element - RTDs.
General information includes tag number, service, P&ID, tank, and quantity.
Process conditions specify fluid phase, design temperature, operating temperature, and pressure.
Temperature sensor details include type (PT100 - 4 wire RTD), accuracy, extension, and material (316 SS).
Thermowell specifications include process connection, material, coating, construction type, and internal connection.
Head features cover, sensor end connection, assembly connection, terminal block, assembly type, and enclosure protection.
Accessories include indicator and identification tag plate.
Manufacturer data includes manufacturer (Krohne) and model (later).
Notes provide design details, junction box usage, and reference to another document for tag list.
The document contains specifications for multiple RTD (Resistance Temperature Detector) elements in hot salt tanks.
There are different positions and levels of temperature sensors within the hot salt tanks.
The design temperature is consistently set at 750°F across all specified RTDs.
The operational temperature varies from 110°F to 270°F depending on the tank position.
All RTD elements are labeled with tags and have specific service descriptions.
